_README: The single list of strings that must never appear anywhere in this public repo.
This file is the ONE place the terms are written down. The leak scanner
(dev/scripts/leakscan.py), the build (dev/integrate.py) and the test guards in
tests/V and tests/B2 all read it, so nobody has to retype a pattern and no copy
can drift. The scanner skips this file and itself and says so in its output.
Patterns are JavaScript/Python-compatible regular expressions, matched
case-insensitively against the whole text of every file in the repo.
Add a pattern here rather than in the code that checks it.

notes.religious: tests/V has guarded the built template for these since SPEC §11; the export widens the guard to the whole repo.
notes.identity: the vault owner's name, e-mail, personal banner image and the name of their private vault.
notes.employer: a second, private build of this system exists for an employer, where a task is a marketing campaign with compliance fields. Neither its content nor the shape of it belongs here.
notes.scratch: rx2, rx3, rx4 … were the working directories this system was built in. A reference to one is a reference to a machine nobody else has.
notes.paths: absolute paths from the machine this was built on. Everything must resolve from the repo root instead, or a clone works nowhere.
